title: Sable and the Harbor
author: Sebastian Halloran
blurb: Marguerite Reyes, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must let someone stay after the last train leaves before the festival ends.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
